GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 312.4 (6 Feb 46) CIS
(SCAPIN - 715)
APO 500
6 February 1946
MEMORANDUM FOR : IMPERIAL JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
SUBJECT : Apprehension of Lt. General SHIMOMURA, Sadamu.
1. The Imperial Japanese Government will apprehend and deliver to the authorities at Sugamo Prison (Tokyo Detention Center) for incarceration, SHIMOMURA, Sadamu, former lieutenant General in the Japanese Army.
2. Delivery at Sugamo Prison will be accomplished immediately.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
B. M. FITCH
Brigadier General, AGD
Adjutant General
